{{Quote|Take me to 79's.''"<br />"''The clone bar?|[[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC Trooper]] [[Fives/Legends|Fives]] and [[Air taxi/Legends|air taxi]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Jay Igno/Legends|Jay Igno]]|<ref name="Orders" />}}
'''79's''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] located on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Offering [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] beverages, [[Music/Legends|music]], and several [[Viewscreen/Legends|vidscreens]] for viewing sporting events, the bar was a bustling establishment popular with a segment of Coruscant's nightlife. Following the authorization of [[Army/Legends|military]] leave for the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of the Republic's [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]], 79's became known for its frequent patronage by the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] during the later [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-spanning [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Description==
[[File:79BarPic2.png|thumb|left|250px|The packed main room of 79's]]
Located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]],<ref name="Orders" /> the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> 79's was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] that operated in the [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|ecumenopolis]]' [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|entertainment district]]. At least two stories in height, 79's was nestled in one of Coruscant's enormous skyscrapers; the bar's main entrance was positioned at one of the building's corners, trimmed by wide walkways and supporting curbside traffic from [[Speeder/Legends|speeders]] and [[Air taxi/Legends|air taxis]]. Two sets of sliding doors allowed customers entrance to 79's, above which the bar boasted a large, brightly lit sign displaying the establishment's name. Inside, an assortment of tables and booths were arranged for patrons to sit at across two floors. In the center of the first floor, a long, oval bar was [[Bartender/Legends|tended]] by several [[2-1B surgical droid]] [[Bartender droid/Legends|droid servers]], led by [[BU-11/Legends|BU-11]].<ref name="FF46">{{FactFile2014|46|BAR 1-4|Robo-bartenders}}</ref> They offered various [[Alcohol/Legends|drinks]], served by several [[BD-3000 luxury droid/Legends|BD-3000 luxury droids]] as [[Waiter/Legends|waitresses]]. 79's maintained a number of [[Viewscreen/Legends|viewscreens]] broadcasting sporting events from around [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], including [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]], and the bar played energetic dance [[Music/Legends|music]] for its patrons. At the back of 79's main room, on the first floor, was as a [[Refresher/Legends|latrine]] for customer use.<ref name="Orders" />

==History==
{{Quote|So, headed out for a little fun on the town, eh? I didn't know clones could ''have'' fun.''"<br />"''There's a lot you don't know about clones.|Jay Ingo and Fives|<ref name="Orders" />}}
[[File:79BarPic1.png|thumb|right|275px|A group of 79's [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] patrons]]
79's opened at a point in [[Time/Legends|time]]<ref name="Orders" /> prior to [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].<ref name="Orders Date">{{TCWdates|604}}</ref> In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the Republic [[Senate Head of Public Affairs]], [[Mar Rugeyan]], had authorized military leave for the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone soldiers]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] at the behest of [[Mercenary/Legends|military contractor]] [[Kal Skirata]].<ref name="TZ">''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]''</ref> 79's soon became a popular destination for [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Troop/Legends|troops]] on Coruscant leave, leading many to identify the establishment simply as a "clone bar," though 79's served numerous other customers who were not clone [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]].<ref name="Orders" />

Near the end of the Clone Wars, circa 20 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]],<ref name="Orders Date" /> the fugitive [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commando]], [[Fives/Legends|CT-5555]]&mdash;known by the nickname Fives&mdash;came to 79's seeking a way to alert the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] to a [[Grand Plan/Legends|conspiracy]] he had unintentionally discovered, and clear his name of the [[Treason/Legends|accusations]] lobbied against him by [[Palpatine/Legends|those]] who wanted [[Order 66/Legends|the danger]] covered up. That night, 79's hosted several dozen off-duty clone [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] and non-clone Republic [[Officer/Legends|officers]], as well as civilian customers of various [[Alien/Legends|races]], including [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]], [[Siniteen/Legends|Siniteen]], and [[Dug/Legends|Dugs]]. Among the patrons in attendance, Fives located his former comrade from the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]], [[Kix/Legends|Kix]]. In the privacy of 79's latrine, Fives arranged for Kix to set up a meeting with [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] in order to help the troubled and framed [[Commando/Legends|commando]]. Soon after, [[Clone shock trooper/Legends|shock troopers]] from the [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]] arrived in pursuit of Fives, forcing the ARC trooper to sneak out of 79's in order to evade capture. A [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] which was outside 79's followed the speeder with Fives without him knowing and eventually led him to be found by the the [[Coruscant Guard]] [[Clone shock trooper/Legends|shock troopers]].<ref name="Orders" />

==Behind the scenes==
79's bar first appeared in the fourth episode of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' television series']] [[The Clone Wars: The Lost Missions|sixth season]], entitled [[Orders (episode)|''Orders'']]. The bar was later mentioned in [[Tim Veekhoven]]'s [[Star Wars Blog]] entry ''[[Sports in the Star Wars Galaxy]]''.
